statement: Framework-specific assertion syntax needs execution context, and a digest name alone supplies no secret semantics. Cejel #427 called a live AVA suite hollow; #430 asserted a timing side-channel for a public digest lookup. The corrections recognize AVA assertions only in active imported-runner callbacks and stop treating bare digest names as authentication evidence, retaining HMAC/MAC/signature controls. Synthetic controls distinguish skipped callbacks, comments, strings, unrelated objects, nested unused functions, public lookups and genuine authentication comparisons. Rule: establish the relevant context before asserting a defect; a removed false finding can make a criterion not applicable and lower the composite through its denominator.

movesWhen.reason: Merge the scoring corrections for Cejel issues #427 and #430 with their paired public-corpus record.
